CustomField.description: Number of units of this Car model currently available for sale. Decremented by the CarSaleEvent__e platform event trigger on each successful sale; must never go negative (see the QuantityAvailable_Cannot_Be_Negative validation rule).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Current stock on hand for this car model. Automatically decremented when a Car Sale Event is processed.
CustomField.label: Quantity Available
